extra_vocab.en: to make something easier or less complicated
extra_vocab.note: 文中說要 simplify the mechanism，指減少零件與步驟，讓機構更簡單。是簡報中說明設計改善好處時很常用的動詞。

example.en: This new template simplifies the way we report monthly sales.
example.zh: 這個新範本簡化了我們回報每月銷售的方式。

example.en: The team simplified the checkout process last quarter.
example.zh: 團隊上一季簡化了結帳流程。

example.en: We are simplifying our price list to avoid confusion.
example.zh: 我們正在簡化價目表以避免混淆。

example.en: A shared calendar will simplify the process of booking meeting rooms.
example.zh: 共用行事曆會簡化預約會議室的流程。

example.en: Engineers plan to simplify the design to reduce production costs.
example.zh: 工程師計畫簡化設計以降低生產成本。

example.en: Please simplify the procedure so new staff can follow it easily.
example.zh: 請簡化程序，讓新進員工能輕鬆照著做。

examples.en: Our goal is to simplify daily work for every department.
examples.zh: 我們的目標是簡化每個部門的日常工作。

examples.en: Using fewer parts would simplify assembly and lower our costs.
examples.zh: 使用較少的零件會簡化組裝並降低我們的成本。

examples.en: Can we simplify the refund form to help customers finish faster?
examples.zh: 我們能簡化退款表單，幫客戶更快填完嗎？

confusable.diff: simple 是形容詞「簡單的」，simplify 是動詞「使變簡單」
confusable.usage: simple 是形容詞（a simple design）；simplify 是動詞，後面接受詞（simplify the design）。

example.en: The instructions are simple, so anyone can follow them.
example.zh: 說明很簡單，所以任何人都能照做。

confusable.diff: simply 是副詞，常表示「只是、僅僅」，不是「簡化」

example.en: We simply need your signature to finish the order.
example.zh: 我們只需要您的簽名就能完成訂單。

similar.diff: streamline 偏重讓流程更順暢有效率；simplify 偏重讓事情不那麼複雜

example.en: We need to streamline the ordering process to save time.
example.zh: 我們需要精簡訂購流程以節省時間。

similar.diff: make ... easier 是較口語的說法，意思和 simplify 接近

example.en: Online forms make it easier for clients to apply.
example.zh: 線上表單讓客戶更容易申請。

example.en: Simpler packaging can reduce our shipping costs by ten percent.
example.zh: 更簡單的包裝可以讓我們的運費減少百分之十。

example.en: The update should improve the speed of the whole system.
example.zh: 這次更新應該能提升整個系統的速度。

derived.link: simple 是詞幹；simplify = simple + -ify（使變成…），像 clarify（使清楚）
simple 變名詞，表示「簡單的狀態」
simplify 去 y 加 -ication，像 apply → application

extra_vocab.en: how well a product works without problems over time
extra_vocab.note: 文中說簡化機構後可能提升 reliability，指產品長期使用時較不容易出故障。多益常見於產品、設備與服務品質的說明。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: reliability 是不可數名詞，不加 s；形容詞是 reliable。

example.en: New testing methods will improve reliability across all our products.
example.zh: 新的測試方法會提升我們所有產品的可靠度。

example.en: Customers often judge a brand by its product reliability.
example.zh: 客戶常以產品可靠度來評斷一個品牌。

example.en: The reliability test runs for two weeks before final approval.
example.zh: 可靠度測試在最終核准前會進行兩週。

examples.en: The brochure highlights the machine's low cost and high reliability.
examples.zh: 手冊強調這台機器成本低又可靠度高。

examples.en: Our main concern is the long-term reliability of the new supplier.
examples.zh: 我們主要的顧慮是新供應商的長期可靠度。

examples.en: Many customers praised the reliability of our delivery service.
examples.zh: 許多客戶稱讚我們配送服務的可靠度。

confusable.diff: liability 是「法律責任；負債」，和「可靠」無關，拼法容易看錯

example.en: The contract limits our liability for late deliveries.
example.zh: 合約限制了我們對延遲交貨的責任。

confusable.diff: reliance 是「依賴」，reliability 是「可靠度」

example.en: Our heavy reliance on one supplier is quite risky.
example.zh: 我們對單一供應商的高度依賴相當有風險。

similar.diff: dependability 語氣較口語，常指人或服務值得信賴；reliability 較常用於產品與系統

example.en: Customers value dependability more than a low price.
example.zh: 客戶重視可信賴度勝過低價。

example.en: The test measures the durability of the plastic frame.
example.zh: 這項測試衡量塑膠框架的耐用度。

example.en: The new model's performance clearly exceeded our expectations.
example.zh: 新機型的性能明顯超出我們的預期。

derived.link: rely 是詞幹，常說 rely on（依靠）
reliable 去 e 加 -y，變副詞

extra_vocab.en: to let go of something that was held or locked
extra_vocab.note: 文中 release the rear wheel swivel locks 指握把旋轉時自動「解除」後輪旋轉鎖，是機械說明常見的用法；與 engage（卡合）相反。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: release A from B 表示把 A 從 B 之中解除或釋放，例如 release the wheels from the lock。

example.en: Pressing this lever releases the brake on both rear wheels.
example.zh: 按下這支拉桿會解除兩個後輪的煞車。

example.en: The company released its annual report on Monday morning.
example.zh: 公司在週一早上發布了年度報告。

example.en: Releasing the button will stop the machine at once.
example.zh: 放開按鈕會讓機器立刻停止。

example.en: Make sure you release the brake before moving the cart.
example.zh: 移動推車前請確認已鬆開煞車。

example.en: The firm plans to release a new product in March.
example.zh: 這家公司計畫在三月推出新產品。

example.en: Our team will draft a press release tomorrow.
example.zh: 我們的團隊明天會起草新聞稿。

examples.en: Slowly release the handle so the arm does not drop suddenly.
examples.zh: 慢慢放開握把，手臂才不會突然掉下來。

examples.en: The bank will release its quarterly results next Friday.
examples.zh: 銀行將在下週五公布季度業績。

confusable.diff: relieve 是「減輕、緩解」，發音和拼法都與 release 相近

example.en: The extra staff will relieve pressure on the sales team.
example.zh: 額外的人手會減輕業務團隊的壓力。

similar.diff: unlock 專指打開「鎖」；release 範圍更廣，也可指放開、發表

example.en: Enter the code to unlock the storage cabinet.
example.zh: 輸入密碼即可打開儲物櫃。

similar.diff: disengage 偏機械脫離、解除卡合，語氣較技術性

example.en: Pull the lever to disengage the gear before cleaning.
example.zh: 清潔前請拉動拉桿讓齒輪脫離。

example.en: Always lock the cabinet before leaving the office.
example.zh: 離開辦公室前請務必鎖上櫃子。

example.en: We will launch the product at the trade show.
example.zh: 我們將在展覽會上推出這項產品。

example.en: We will release the updated schedule by this afternoon.
example.zh: 我們會在今天下午前發布更新後的時程表。

example.en: The press release explains how the policy will change.
example.zh: 新聞稿說明了政策將如何改變。

senses.en: to open or unlock something so it can move freely
senses.distinguish: 指鎖、煞車、握把等機械零件

example.en: Press the button to release the lock on the door.
example.zh: 按下按鈕即可解除門鎖。

senses.en: to make a product or information available to the public

example.en: The company will release the new software update next month.
example.zh: 公司下個月將推出新的軟體更新。

senses.en: to allow money or items to be used

example.en: Finance will release the funds once the contract is signed.
example.zh: 合約簽署後，財務部會撥出資金。

extra_vocab.en: to connect or lock into place
extra_vocab.note: 文中 the swivel locks would automatically engage again 指後輪旋轉鎖會再次「卡合」鎖住，與前面的 release（解除）相對。engage 在多益還常見「參與」「吸引」「聘請」等意思。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: engage 當「卡合」時，可直接接受詞或當不及物動詞（The gear engages）；當「從事」時要用 engage in + 名詞或 V-ing。

example.en: The brake engages automatically when the user lets go.
example.zh: 使用者放手時，煞車會自動卡合。

example.en: The two firms engaged in talks for several months.
example.zh: 兩家公司洽談了好幾個月。

example.en: Engaged employees usually stay with the company longer.
example.zh: 投入工作的員工通常會在公司待得更久。

example.en: She is engaging a new designer for the project.
example.zh: 她正在為這個專案聘請一位新設計師。

example.en: Remember to engage the lock before moving the cart.
example.zh: 移動推車前記得啟動鎖定。

example.en: Staff may not engage in personal business during work hours.
example.zh: 員工在工作時間內不得從事私人事務。

example.en: Social media helps us engage customers between product launches.
example.zh: 社群媒體幫助我們在新品發表之間與客戶互動。

examples.en: The gear should engage smoothly without any noise.
examples.zh: 齒輪應該順暢卡合，不發出任何噪音。

examples.en: Managers must engage their teams in the planning process.
examples.zh: 主管必須讓團隊參與規劃過程。

confusable.diff: involve 是「涉及、包含」，沒有「卡合」或「聘請」的意思

example.en: The new project will involve three different departments.
example.zh: 這個新專案會牽涉三個不同部門。

confusable.diff: employ 指僱用員工；engage 的「聘請」多指短期的顧問或專業人士

example.en: The factory employs about two hundred workers in total.
example.zh: 這間工廠總共僱用了大約兩百名員工。

similar.diff: activate 指啟動某項功能；engage 強調機件互相卡住、接合

example.en: Press the key twice to activate the alarm.
example.zh: 按兩下按鍵即可啟動警報。

similar.diff: lock into place 是較口語的片語，指固定到定位

example.en: The panel will lock into place with a click.
example.zh: 面板會發出喀聲並固定到位。

example.en: This machine operates on a simple spring system.
example.zh: 這台機器以簡單的彈簧系統運作。

example.en: Please attach the cover securely before first use.
example.zh: 初次使用前請把護蓋牢牢裝上。

senses.en: to connect or lock into place
senses.distinguish: 主詞是鎖、齒輪、煞車等機件

example.en: The safety lock will engage once the door is fully closed.
example.zh: 門完全關上後，安全鎖就會卡合。

senses.en: to take part in an activity

example.en: The two companies engage in joint research every year.
example.zh: 這兩家公司每年都進行共同研究。

senses.en: to get someone's attention and interest
senses.distinguish: 受詞是人，表示抓住注意力

example.en: A short quiz can engage students during the training session.
example.zh: 一個簡短測驗可以讓學員在訓練課程中更投入。

senses.en: to hire someone for a job
senses.distinguish: 多指聘請顧問、律師等專業人士

example.en: We plan to engage a lawyer to review the contract.
example.zh: 我們打算聘請律師來審閱合約。

extra_vocab.en: a strong thick wire or set of wires
extra_vocab.note: 文中 control cable 指握把內連接按鈕與鎖定機構的控制鋼索；每多一個按鈕就多一條，是機構變複雜的原因，所以減少按鈕就能省下一條 cable。

example.en: Each machine needs two separate cables for power and data.
example.zh: 每台機器需要兩條獨立的電源與資料纜線。

example.en: A broken control cable can stop the brake from working.
example.zh: 斷掉的控制鋼索會讓煞車無法作動。

example.en: Please unplug the power cable before cleaning the device.
example.zh: 清潔裝置前請先拔掉電源線。

example.en: IT staff replaced the network cable in the meeting room.
example.zh: 資訊人員更換了會議室的網路線。

examples.en: I need a longer cable to connect the monitor.
examples.zh: 我需要一條更長的線來連接螢幕。

examples.en: The order includes one cable and a spare charger.
examples.zh: 這筆訂單包含一條纜線和一個備用充電器。

confusable.diff: cabinet 是「櫃子」，拼法開頭相似

example.en: Store the spare parts in the cabinet near the printer.
example.zh: 備用零件請放在印表機旁的櫃子裡。

confusable.diff: capable 是形容詞「有能力的」，發音開頭與 cable 相近

example.en: The new system is capable of handling large files.
example.zh: 新系統有能力處理大型檔案。

similar.diff: wire 多指較細的金屬線或電線；cable 通常較粗、較堅固，或由多條線組成

example.en: The technician replaced a damaged wire inside the panel.
example.zh: 技術人員更換了面板內一條受損的電線。

similar.diff: cord 多指連接家電的軟電線

example.en: The cord on this lamp is too short.
example.zh: 這盞燈的電線太短了。

example.en: This connector fits both old and new models.
example.zh: 這個連接器適用於新舊兩種型號。

example.en: Make sure the plug is firmly in the socket.
example.zh: 請確認插頭已牢牢插進插座。

derived.link: cable + -ing，把整套纜線變成名詞，像 building、parking

senses.en: a strong thick wire used to pull, hold, or control something
senses.distinguish: 指機械中的粗鋼索或控制索

example.en: A steel cable holds the sign above the entrance.
example.zh: 一條鋼索把招牌固定在入口上方。

senses.en: a covered wire that carries power or data

example.en: Use a USB cable to transfer the files to your laptop.
example.zh: 請用 USB 連接線把檔案傳到你的筆電。

senses.en: a television service sent through cables

example.en: The sports event will be shown on cable tonight.
example.zh: 這場體育賽事今晚會在有線電視播出。

extra_vocab.en: different from the usual one and possible to choose instead
extra_vocab.note: 文中 an alternative approach 指從專利角度的「另一種做法」。alternative 強調可選擇的其他方案，不一定要完全取代原本的設計。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 名詞用法常說 an alternative to + 名詞（…的替代方案），to 不能換成 of。

example.en: We reviewed three alternatives before choosing the final supplier.
example.zh: 我們在選定最終供應商前審視了三個替代方案。

example.en: Let's consider an alternative approach to the delivery schedule.
example.zh: 我們來考慮另一種安排交貨時程的做法。

example.en: We have an alternative plan if the shipment is delayed.
example.zh: 如果貨物延誤，我們有備用計畫。

example.en: We have no alternative but to postpone the launch.
example.zh: 我們別無選擇，只能延後上市。

examples.en: Do you have an alternative solution to this problem?
examples.zh: 你有針對這個問題的替代解決方案嗎？

examples.en: We offer an alternative model if this one is out of stock.
examples.zh: 如果這款缺貨，我們提供另一款替代機型。

confusable.diff: alternate 是「輪流、隔一個」，alternative 才是「另一個可選的」
confusable.usage: alternate 當動詞是「輪流」，當形容詞可指「交替的」；要說「替代方案」請用 alternative。

example.en: The two teams alternate weekends on the support desk.
example.zh: 兩個團隊輪流值週末的客服櫃檯。

similar.diff: substitute 指直接取代原物的東西；alternative 指可選擇的另一種方案，不一定取代

example.en: Margarine can be a substitute for butter in this recipe.
example.zh: 在這個食譜中，人造奶油可以代替奶油。

similar.diff: option 泛指可供選擇的選項，不一定與原方案「不同」

example.en: The second option costs less but takes longer.
example.zh: 第二個選項比較便宜，但需要更久。

example.en: The client made a wise choice of venue.
example.zh: 客戶選了一個很明智的場地。

example.en: We will send a replacement within two business days.
example.zh: 我們會在兩個工作天內寄出替換品。

derived.link: alternative + -ly 變副詞，用來提出另一個選項，像 quickly
alternate 是詞幹，加 -ive 變 alternative，像 active、creative

example.en: The agency suggested an alternative route to avoid traffic delays.
example.zh: 旅行社建議走另一條路線以避開塞車。

example.en: Riding the train is a cheaper alternative to driving.
example.zh: 搭火車是比開車更便宜的替代方式。
